name: stockism
description: Lookism Character Stock Exchange - Community Edition

scripts.emulators: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.build:functions: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('functions/lib', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p functions
scripts.test:discord: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core discordCommands.test"
scripts.test:discord:endpoint: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core discordEndpoint.test"
scripts.test:emulator: npm run test:emulator:core && npm run test:eventmarket
scripts.test:emulator:core: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only auth,firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only auth,firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core firestoreRules.test"
scripts.test:ipcap: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core ipCap.test"
scripts.test:trading: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core trading.test"
scripts.test:limitorders: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core limitOrders.test"
scripts.test:premarket: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core preMarket.test"
scripts.test:exploits: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only auth,firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core exploitFixes.test"
scripts.test:dividends: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core dividends.test"
scripts.test:ladder: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core ladder.test"
scripts.test:eventmarket: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project functions"
scripts.test:drophalt: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core dropHalt.test"
scripts.test:collapse: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core reviewCollapse.test"
scripts.test:pricehistory: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core priceHistorySplit.test"
scripts.test:loyalty: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core loyaltyNotify.test"
scripts.test:crewroles: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core crewRoles.test"
scripts.test:leaderboard: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core leaderboard.test"
scripts.test:crewswitch: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core crewSwitch.test"
scripts.test:season: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core season.test"
scripts.test:coord: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core coord.test"
scripts.test:split: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core stockSplit.test"
scripts.test:rename: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator-test.json --only firestore "vitest run -c tests/emulator/vitest.config.js --project core renameTicker.test"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p functions --noEmit
